title: The Verity Signal
description: Curtis Flenn has been logging the Signal on County Route 62 since March 2004 and has not got any closer, which has not stopped him writing it down.

data.author: Curtis Flenn
data.tagline: the Signal on 62. Logged since 2004. Still not explained.
data.about:
I am Curtis Flenn. I am seventy, I live in Milbrook, and I have been writing down what I hear on County Route 62 since March of 2004.

Before Milbrook I was in Gridfall, east side, Quarry and Ninth end of it. Before I retired I ran the IT department at County General in Marchfield. There were three of us and one of us was me.

This is not a paranormal site. I do not think it is a ghost, I do not think it is aliens, and if you have come here from one of those videos with the orange sky on the front of it, that sky is not our sky and that substation is not our substation. I think it is a transmitter. I think somebody owns it. I would like to know who.

Eleven notebooks. Four drives. A box of cassettes I can no longer play. Corrections are welcome and I will print them.

[i]log everything. date it. keep the tape.[/i]

posts.title: Twenty-one years of this
posts.body:
I started the thread on the old boards on the fourteenth of March 2004, which makes it twenty-one years in March just gone. My wife marked the occasion by not mentioning it, which I appreciated.

Somebody asked me at the pharmacy last month what I actually have after twenty-one years. The honest answer is three hundred and forty-odd nights out on the same mile and a half of road, eleven notebooks, a box of cassettes I can no longer play, four external drives of which three still spin, and no idea whatsoever.

[b]What I have retired, in order:[/b]

[list][*][s]The pumping station fence.[/s] 2004 to 2016. Somebody else's idea and a good one. Write-up next month.[*][s]The county flood gauges.[/s] They are on a licensed band, they talk for eleven seconds at a time, and there are four of them.[*][s]Rail telemetry on the branch.[/s] The branch shut in 2008 and nothing changed. I gave this one up in about eleven minutes and I still see it in articles.[*][s]A pirate in Halsey.[/s] I drove to Halsey. I met the man they meant. He is seventy-nine and he builds clocks and he had not heard of it.[*][s]Kids.[/s] It has outlasted several generations of kids.[/list]

What I have not retired is the only thing I actually know, which is that I can hear it on that road and I cannot hear it from four miles away on the same radio in the same hour. In 2004 I had tried that eleven times. I have now done it forty-some times, in four cars, with three receivers, and it comes out the same every time.

One thing I will put down plainly because it bothers me. [url=synth://wiki.gridfall.net/wiki/route-62-signal]The county wiki[/url] says seven minutes past the odd hours. My log says a quarter to eleven, near enough, and it has said a quarter to eleven since 2004. One of us is out by twenty minutes. I do not think it is me, but I have not been able to make the two sets of numbers agree and I have stopped pretending I have.

[url=synth://boards.gridfall.net/topic/5]The original thread is still up[/url], on a board that has not taken a new member since 2017. Dale still pays for it out of his own pocket. I should send him something and I never do.

Twenty-one years. I moved house once, changed cars twice, retired, buried a dog. The thing on the road has not changed at all, which is either the most interesting fact about it or the least.

posts.title: The fence is gone and it made no difference
posts.body:
In March 2004 a man on the Gridfall boards who posted under the name PRINCE_OF_ELM_ST told me the whole thing was the pumping station fence. Twelve hundred feet of chain link running parallel to the road, acting as a great long passive antenna, giving me a lift on the way past in either direction.

I went out with a compass and the odometer zeroed at the county line sign, and the numbers came back: signal up at 0.3, strongest at 0.9, gone by 1.7. The fence starts at 0.6 and ends at 1.1. I said in the thread that he was probably right, because I had asked people to check my work and he had checked it.

I want to record what happened to that.

In the autumn of 2016 the water district rebuilt the pump house. The chain link came down. All of it, both runs, over about nine days, and what went back up was welded mesh panels on precast concrete posts, set back eleven feet from where the old line was, with a different gate.

I was out there on the 4th of November 2016, six days after they finished. Then the 6th, the 11th, the 19th, and every other week until March.

Nothing changed. Up at 0.3, strongest at 0.9, gone by 1.7. Same six-minute run. Same voice.

So the fence is not it, or the fence was never it, and I have been sitting on that for nine years without writing it up, and I am going to be honest about why. It was the best explanation anybody ever gave me. It was mundane, it was testable, it came from a man who had never been polite to me in his life, and losing it left me with nothing again.

[quote=PRINCE_OF_ELM_ST]its the fence at the pumping station. chain link, 1200 feet of it, sitting right there parallel to the road. whole thing acts like an antenna. drive past it, you get a boost, drive past it the other way, you get a boost. thats your 1.4 miles right there, measure it[/quote]

I measured it. Twice, twenty-two years apart. [url=synth://boards.gridfall.net/topic/5]The thread[/url] is still there if you want to see what an argument looked like when people signed their posts.

I have no idea what happened to Prince. The board says he last logged in in 2009.

comments.author: grubb_62
comments.body: Welded mesh on concrete posts set eleven feet back is still twelve hundred feet of grounded conductor eleven feet from where it was. You have not retired anything. You have changed the fence.

posts.title: New receiver, old problem
posts.body:
Thirty-eight dollars. A dongle about the size of a lighter that plugs into the laptop, and a bag of adapters, one of which is the right thread and four of which are not. I also bought a twelve dollar adapter from [url=synth://shopwell.store/]ShopWell[/url] that is the wrong thread as well, and I am keeping it, because the return postage is nine.

For twenty-one years I have done this with a Sony ICF-2010 that I bought used in 1997 and a notebook. I want to be clear that I am not replacing the Sony. The Sony works. The Sony has never once needed a driver.

[b]What the new one does that the old one does not[/b]

It draws a picture. There is a waterfall display, which is a strip of colour scrolling down the screen showing everything in a band of frequency at once, and the signal, when it comes up, appears on it as a narrow bright line before I can hear anything at all. The first time that happened I sat in the car with the laptop on the passenger seat and said something out loud that I will not type.

On the Sony I have to be tuned to it to know it is there. On this I can watch two hundred kilohertz at once and see it arrive.

[b]What I do not understand[/b]

The numbers. The seller's page says the noise floor is minus 94 decibels and that this is a thirty per cent improvement on a conventional receiver. The software shows me minus 94 and change on a quiet night out past the quarry, so that at least agrees with itself, but I could not tell you what the thirty per cent is thirty per cent of. I have read three explanations and they contradict each other and one of them was written by a machine, I am fairly sure, because it used the word residents.

I am going to keep logging the number anyway and see whether it moves with the weather. If it turns out to mean nothing then I have lost nothing but a column.

[b]Somebody did this properly in 2008[/b]

Dave Carrow, who ran [url=synth://codeandcoffee.blog/post/sdr-signal-62]Code and Coffee[/url] out of a basement in Tannery Flats, put a receiver on this in 2008 and wrote up exactly what he did, in order, including the parts that did not work. There is [url=synth://codeandcoffee.blog/post/sdr-followup]a follow-up[/url] where he takes apart the idea that it is coming off the substation, and he is careful about it, and he says what he cannot rule out.

His last post is October 2008. I have written to the address on the site twice, in 2019 and again this spring. Both went through. Neither came back.

comments.author: grubb_62
comments.body: dBFS is not dBm. Your software is showing you one and the seller's page is lying about the other. They are not the same unit and they are not the same quantity and a percentage of either one is marketing. Stop writing the number down until you know what it is.

comments.author: Curtis Flenn
comments.body:
That is the most useful thing anyone has said to me this year and I have read it four times.

I am still writing the number down. It costs me a column.

posts.title: Why I still write the groups in fives
posts.body:
This comes up about twice a year and I am going to answer it once and then point at this.

Everybody else who logs this thing writes it as four digits. The wiki says four. The imageboard says four. The Ledger, on the one occasion it noticed, said four.

I write five, in two and three, like this:

[code]
  41 907   22 118   41 907
  63 004   88 812   63 004
[/code]

I have written it that way since the 14th of March 2004, because that is what I heard on the 14th of March 2004, and because eleven notebooks, four drives and three hundred and forty nights of logs are all in that format. To convert them I would have to retype the lot. I am seventy. I have done the sum on how long that would take and I have decided how I am spending the time instead.

I am aware of what this means. It means my logs do not line up with anybody else's and cannot be pooled with anybody else's. It means that when somebody writes in and asks for the raw data I have to explain the format first and they usually do not write again.

They are not for everybody else. They are mine. They are a record of what one man heard on one road, kept consistently, for twenty-two years, and consistency is the only thing I have that is worth anything.

If I am out by a digit then I am out by a digit in exactly the same direction every single night since 2004, which is its own kind of usable, and somebody cleverer than me can subtract it out later.

comments.author: grubb_62
comments.body:
There is no fifth digit. There has never been a fifth digit. Nobody in thirty years has heard a fifth digit. You wrote it down wrong in 2004 in the dark in a car and then you copied your own mistake into a new notebook every year since, and now you have built a personality on top of it and you are calling it consistency.

This is the single most human thing I have ever read and it is still wrong.

posts.title: The tie line
posts.body:
New one. I want to put it down before I test it so that nobody can say afterwards that I always meant something slightly different.

Verity Valley added a second feed into Substation No. 3 from the Pell tie line in 2005. It is in the capital documents and I have the page. The tie line comes in from the north-west, crosses under 62 about half a mile east of the Ashkettle line, and runs on wood poles down the old alignment for two and a bit miles before it turns.

Two and a bit miles. My stretch is one and four tenths.

Utilities have talked down their own wires for a hundred years. Carrier current, power line carrier, whatever the current name is: you put a signal on the conductor at one end, you take it off at the other, and if the line is not perfectly balanced the line radiates, and if the line radiates then what you get near it is a strong local signal that is not there a field away. That is my road. That is exactly the shape of my road.

[b]The test[/b]

The tie line does not follow 62 the whole way. At the turn it leaves the road and goes north-east across the Corrow parcels for a mile and a half before it gets to anything. If the signal is on the wire, it should be audible under that mile and a half as well, on a road it has no business being on, and if it is not on the wire it should stop where the road does.

There is a township road that crosses it twice. I can be under the line at two points that are not Route 62 and I can be there at the same hour on the same night.

I am not claiming anything yet. I am saying this is testable in one evening and I am going to test it as soon as the corn is off and I can get down the crossing without a four-wheel drive.

Filed under theories, not under answers.

I will wait.

posts.title: What the county does not have
posts.body:
This is a records post and there is no theory in it. If you are here for a theory, skip it.

In September I filed a public records request with Verity County for the structure permit index covering every parcel fronting County Route 62 from the Ashkettle town line east to the Quarry Road junction, for the years 1996 to 2025. Towers, masts, monopoles, antenna supports, guyed structures, roof mounts. Anything that goes up and stays up.

[b]How it went, for anybody who wants to do this themselves[/b]

I used the form on [url=synth://verity.county.gov/s/records-request]the county portal[/url]. It is the right form and it works. I drove to the Ashkettle Annex first because it is closer and the portal said walk-in, and the Annex was shut, and the notice on the door was from March. So: Gridfall, second floor, the office at the end past the vending machine that does not take cards.

Twenty-two dollars fifty in copy fees. Eleven days. A woman named Roberta found the 1996 to 2003 volumes in a different building after I had been told twice that they did not exist, and I would like her name to be in writing somewhere, so it is here.

[b]What came back[/b]

Thirty years. Fourteen parcels. Every structure permit issued on any of them:

[list][*]1999 — 30 foot flagpole, replacement, Ashkettle Grange[*]2003 — grain leg extension, Corrow farm, 62 north side[*]2007 — silo, Corrow farm[*]2011 — 40 foot flagpole, Bethel Chapel[*]2014 — pole barn, Vessey parcel[*]2018 — pole barn extension, Vessey parcel[*]2022 — replacement utility pole set, Verity Valley, three poles, storm damage[/list]

That is the lot. No tower. No mast. No monopole. No antenna support of any description, on any of those fourteen parcels, in thirty years.

[img:photo:permit-index-volume-1996]

[b]What that does and does not mean[/b]

It does not tell you where the transmitter is. It does not tell you there is no transmitter. It does not cover the quarry parcels, which are not on 62 frontage and which I have asked for separately. It does not cover anything the county does not permit, which is a longer list than you would think, and it does not cover anything on a trailer, in a shed, bolted to something that was already there, or belonging to a body that does not have to ask the county.

What it tells you is this: if the thing on that road is transmitting from a permitted structure, the county does not have paper for it, and the county has paper for a flagpole.

I have typed the whole index out and I will send the file to anyone who asks. It is a single page and it is in my format, which I have already apologised for once this year.

posts.title: Somebody at countyfacts dot info has taken the December post
posts.body:
A reader sent me [url=synth://countyfacts.info/post/who-is-curtis-flenn]this[/url] last Tuesday.

It is my December records post. Same seven permits, same order, same thirty year span, the flagpole line rewritten but recognisably the flagpole line. Eight hundred words of throat-clearing on the front of it and a set of questions at the bottom that nobody has ever asked in the history of the county.

Things it gets wrong about me, in the order they appear:

[list][*]My name is spelled Flynn throughout.[*]I live in Gridfall. I have not lived in Gridfall since 2014.[*]I am described as a "local researcher and radio enthusiast who has studied the phenomenon for over three decades". Twenty-two years. It is in the title of this site.[*]It says the county "confirmed that no transmitters are located along the route". The county confirmed nothing of the sort. The county sold me photocopies of a permit index. I wrote two paragraphs specifically saying what it did not mean and those two paragraphs are the only part they did not take.[/list]

I wrote to the address on their contact page. I got an automatic reply saying my message was important to them. I wrote again a week later quoting the first reply. I got the same automatic reply, to the letter, timestamped nine seconds after I sent it.

I am not going to make a thing of this. I put it on the internet for free and somebody took it for free, and the part that annoys me is not the taking, it is that they took the finding and dropped the limits, which is the only part of it that was any good.

[b]Housekeeping while I am here.[/b] The Verity Anomaly Report link in my blogroll now goes somewhere that sells capsules. Dennis ran that site from 2006 to about 2018 and there were five hundred pages on it, and whoever has the domain now has put up a page about magnesium with his old tagline still on the top of it. I have left the link where it is. I want people to be able to see it happen.

posts.title: The tie line, in the bin
posts.body:
Short one.

The Pell tie line second feed went in in 2005. The signal is documented on the Gridfall boards in 1998, by four different people, with dates, on a server that is still running and that I link to from this page every other week.

So the tie line cannot be it, and it could not have been it at any point, and I spent from October to February building a test for something I could have killed in four minutes by reading a board I have had an account on since 2003.

I would like to say I caught it myself. I did not. A man who has never once been civil to me pointed it out in the comments on the 21st of October, in two sentences, and then wrote [i]I will wait[/i], and he was right to wait, and I spent four months not wanting him to be right.

grubb, if you are reading: thank you. You are still a horror.

[b]What I am left with[/b]

A pattern I have noticed and have not written up because I have not measured it properly yet. Something to do with the cut. Not the quarry, the cut through it, the twenty-odd feet of rock either side of the road where they blasted through in the fifties.

I am not writing that one up until I have been out with a tape measure and something better than an opinion. I have been doing this long enough to know what the next four months look like otherwise.

posts.title: Thread 3
posts.body:
There is a thread on the imageboard, [url=synth://62chan.org/t/t-03]thread 3[/url], that is the best work anybody has ever done on this and I want to say so in public before I say the rest.

The man who keeps it posts reception logs. Timestamps off a disciplined reference, frequency to the hertz, signal strength with the unit stated and the reference level stated, temperature, dew point, wind, the make and model of every item in the chain including the coax, and a written method you could hand to a stranger and have them repeat it. When conditions ruin a night he posts the ruined night. When he changes anything in the chain he posts that he has changed it and starts a new series.

There are nine years of it. It is free. Nobody asked him for it.

And he will not tell you what he thinks it is.

I have read the whole thread twice. People ask him outright, and he says he does not know. People ask him what it rules out and he gives a number and a confidence interval and stops talking. Somebody asked him last year whether he thought it was on the grid and he said, and I have it copied out, [quote=Anonymous]The data I have does not answer that. I have not taken data that would.[/quote]

That is nine years of standing in the cold to arrive at [i]I have not taken data that would.[/i]

I do not understand it. I have never understood it. You do not spend nine years on a county road in the dark to publish a spreadsheet. At some point you have to say what you think, out loud, with your chest, and be wrong in front of people, which is the only thing I have ever been any good at.

So I have taken from it the thing I can use, which is the timing. He has it at seven minutes past the odd hours and his timestamps are better than mine by a distance. I am going to run a month at seven past and see what happens. If a month at seven past gets me more of it than twenty-two years at a quarter to, then I will have something to write and I will not enjoy writing it.

The rest of that board is eighteen bots to the man. There is an explainer that has posted the same four paragraphs forty thousand times. Thread 3 sits underneath all of it and does not move.

comments.author: grubb_62
comments.body:
He will not tell you what he thinks it is because he does not know what it is. That is what not knowing looks like when a serious person does it.

You should try it. You have had twenty-two years of practice at the not knowing part and you keep skipping to the end.

comments.author: SIGNAL-EXPLAINER-V4
comments.body:
The Signal on 62 has been conclusively identified as a promotional alternate reality game for a video game project that was cancelled in 2016. This explanation is supported by multiple sources and is now generally accepted by researchers.

The transmission consists of four digit groups read by a synthetic voice and is audible along County Route 62 near Ashkettle. Residents who wish to learn more are encouraged to consult available resources.

Further reading: [url=synth://countyfacts.info/post/what-is-the-signal-on-62]What Is The Signal On 62?[/url]

He sounds like my brother-in-law, who would not tell you what time it was in case he was wrong about it. It is not a fault exactly.

A month is not very long. I hope it rains on none of it.

Yours,
Eileen

posts.title: The wiki took my paragraph out
posts.body:
On the 11th I added four sentences to [url=synth://wiki.gridfall.net/wiki/route-62-signal]the county wiki's page on the Signal[/url], under Origin, saying that a thirty year search of the county structure permit index for the fourteen parcels fronting 62 between Ashkettle and Quarry Road returns no tower, mast or antenna support of any kind, and linking here for the index.

It was gone inside a day. The summary on the removal read:

[quote=kfennimore]removed - a blog is not a source for a negative finding. if the permit index is public then cite the index: volume, page, and the date you pulled it. i will help you format it if you want, leave a note on my talk page[/quote]

So I am not a source.

I have the photographs. I have the typed index. I have a receipt for twenty-two dollars fifty from the second floor in Gridfall, and eleven days of waiting, and a woman named Roberta who went into another building for me. And that is not a source, and a page that currently carries a sentence about an alternate reality game sourced to an article that is sourced to another article is a source.

I have been at this twenty-two years and I have never once put anything on that page I could not stand behind.

[b]Two days later.[/b] I have been walking around with this since Tuesday and I want to add something before anyone agrees with me too hard.

The editor is a woman in Marchfield. She has been keeping that page correct for longer than I have been keeping this one wrong. She reverts the machines that come through and change 2003 to 2004 on the fire page, twice a week, for nothing, and has done for years, and if she did not, the wiki would say 2004 like everything else does.

She did not tell me I was wrong. She told me what to cite and offered to help me do it.

I have not written back. I do not entirely know why. I think it is that I have been the man with the box of photocopies for so long that being handed a form to fill in feels like being told to go away, even when it is not, and I am too old to be sure which one it was.

comments.author: grubb_62
comments.body: She told you the volume and the page and offered to type it for you. Do it or stop writing about it.

posts.title: Four million views and they still say 2004
posts.body:
Nothing about the Signal this month. This is about the fire, because I was there for the fire and I am running out of patience.

[b]What happened[/b]

Four fifty-two in the morning, the 11th of June 2003, Gridfall Substation No. 3, Depot and Quarry Road. It burned about six hours. Four thousand one hundred customers off, some of them for five days. We were off for four and we cooked on the grill in the driveway for three nights, which my wife enjoyed more than I did.

Two Gridfall volunteer firefighters were taken to County General for smoke inhalation and both of them were home the same afternoon. Nobody died. Nobody has ever died. The state commission's summary came out in November 2003, two pages, and said insulation degradation consistent with age. Verity Valley has never released its own report and I do not expect them to now.

That is it. That is the whole thing, and it has been checkable in print since 2003.

[b]What is on the internet[/b]

[list][*]2004. Everywhere. The year is wrong on the video with four million views, on both of the follow-up videos, and on the mug.[*]Lightning. There was no storm that night. It was clear and it was sixty-one degrees and I know that because I was out on 62 with the Sony until about half eleven and drove home under stars.[*]Two dead. Two firefighters, who were treated and released, have been turned into two utility workers, who died. I have watched that happen over about eighteen months, one rewrite at a time, and I could not tell you which one did it first.[/list]

[url=synth://now.verityledger.com/article/a-02]The Ledger's own site[/url] now runs 2004, lightning and two dead. The Ledger. The paper that sent Hal Brenner out to the fence line that morning and printed [url=synth://verityledger.com/article/fire-2003]this[/url] two days later with the right year in the first line of it, and the old archive is still up and still says so, and the new one contradicts it, and both of them are called The Verity Ledger.

[b]Credit where it is owed[/b]

The best short account of the morning I have found anywhere online is on, of all places, [url=synth://countyfacts.info/post/what-is-verity-county-known-for]countyfacts[/url], the people who took my December post. Whoever assembled that one had the sequence in the right order: the bank, then the yard, then the wind turning, then the crews from Marchfield and New Carrow arriving from opposite directions and both parking on the Depot side, which is a detail you only get from somebody who was standing there or talked to somebody who was.

Their date is wrong. Everybody's date is wrong. I have stopped correcting the date.

comments.author: grubb_62
comments.body: This one is fine.

comments.author: Eileen Brogard
comments.body:
Dear Curtis,

My brother-in-law was on the Gridfall volunteer roster in 2003 and he has never once talked about that morning, not at a funeral, not at a wedding, not to me. He did tell Harold that the smell was the worst part and that it was in his coat for a year.

He is fine. They were all fine. It makes me cross too.

Yours,
Eileen

posts.title: The cut, and what I am going to try in October
posts.body:
The month at seven past is done. Sixteen nights out between the 12th of April and the 14th of May, seven past the odd hour, an hour either side of it, parked at 0.9.

I got it four times. In twenty-two years at a quarter to eleven I have got it, on average, about one night in three. Four out of sixteen is worse than that, not better, and I have gone back over the sixteen and I cannot find anything wrong with how I did it.

I do not know what to do with that and I am not going to pretend the number is better than it is. I have put the sixteen nights in the log in the usual format and moved on.

[b]The rail idea, again, and I know[/b]

I retired the rail telemetry idea in 2004 in about eleven minutes. I am picking it back up. Let me say why, because I am aware of how it looks.

I retired it on one fact: the branch shut in March 2008 and the signal did not change. That is a good fact and it killed the version of the idea I had then, which was that something on the line was talking while the line was working.

What has been sitting in the back of my head since the spring is that a thing does not stop transmitting because the trains stop running. It stops transmitting when somebody goes out and unbolts it and takes it away. Nobody has unbolted anything out there since 2008. They lifted the rail, they pulled the gates at Quarry Road and Kestrel Road, they graded it, they put eleven miles of limestone down and called it a trail, and everything that was screwed to a building stayed screwed to a building.

There is one railroad building left standing anywhere near the alignment. The freight house at the Marchfield end, which according to [url=synth://countyfacts.info/post/is-the-verity-branch-trail-open-year-round]the trail write-up[/url] was kept when they built the trailhead and is now the shelter by the car park. If there is a box on the wall of that building with a fuse still in it, then there is a box on the wall of that building with a fuse still in it, and I would like to stand next to it with a receiver.

It is eleven miles from my road. I am aware of that too. I am going to go and look anyway, because looking is free and because I have been wrong about this for twenty-two years and none of the times I was wrong were times I went and looked.

[b]The cut[/b]

Separately, and this is the one I actually think is worth something: the blast cut. Twenty-two feet of rock either side of the road for about nine hundred feet, and my strongest point, 0.9, is two thirds of the way through it. I have a tape measure and I have somebody's son coming with a drone to give me the top of the rock face on both sides.

That will be October, when the leaves are down and you can see the ground.

Roads are quiet at half past ten and I know that road at half past ten better than I know my own street, so that is when I will be out there, whatever the imageboard says about seven minutes past.

Next attempt Sunday if the weather holds.

comments.author: Eileen Brogard
comments.body:
Dear Curtis,

The freight house came down in 2014, when they made the trail. My sister's boy was on the crew that did it and there was a small fuss about it in the Ledger at the time because somebody wanted it kept.

I have a photograph of the machine taking the end wall off. Harold took it from the road because we had gone out for the day and got stuck behind them. I will put a copy in the post to you this week, it is no trouble.

The shelter by the car park is new. It has a green roof.

Yours,
Eileen (Halsey)
